SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.JM_NM AS jmNm , t1.STOCK_GB AS stockGb , t1.JASAN_GB AS jasanGb , t1.SEQ_NO AS seqNo , t1.BALH_NATION AS balhNation , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , t1.IJA_PER AS ijaPer , TO_CHAR(t1.BALH_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS balhYmd , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGHW_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghwYmd , t1.AEKM AS aekm , TO_CHAR(t1.SANGJ_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sangjYmd , t1.SANGJ_JUSU AS sangjJusu , t1.GYULJE_JM AS gyuljeJm , t1.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , t1.ISIN_CD AS isinCd , t1.IJA_BDC AS ijaBdc , t1.IJA_DCF AS ijaDcf , t1.JASAN_ATTR AS jasanAttr , t1.SJ_GB AS sjGb , TO_CHAR(t1.LSY_YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lsyYmd , t1.UNIT_AEK AS unitAek , t1.HANGSA_GA AS hangsaGa , t1.JASAN AS jasan , t1.SEDOL AS sedol , t1.SIGA_AGENT AS sigaAgent , t1.CHANGE_CURRENCY AS changeCurrency , t1.CHANGE_EX_RT AS changeExRt , t1.CHANGE_JM_CD AS changeJmCd , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.CHANGE_JM_CD) AS xxChangeJmCd , 1 AS pVisible FROM SYM0YA t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JASAN_GB = 'A'
AND t1.LSY_YMD >= TRUNC(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{lsyYmd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD')
ORDER BY t1.BALH_NATION ASC, t1.JM_CD ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.JM_CD AS jmCd , t1.JONGA AS jonga , t1.DANGA AS danga , TO_CHAR(t1.LOAD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS loadTime , TO_CHAR(t1.PX_CLOSE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxCloseDt , t1.PX_LAST AS pxLast , TO_CHAR(t1.PX_DT_1D, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pxDt1d , t1.PX_CLOSE_1D AS pxClose1d , t1.PX_YEST_CLOSE_EXCH_UNADJ AS pxYestCloseExchUnadj , t1.BLBG_TCKR AS blbgTckr , t1.ISIN_CD AS isinCd , t1.CURRENCY AS currency , t1.HANGSA_GA AS hangsaGa , t1.BID AS bid , t1.ASK AS ask , t1.TIME_GA AS timeGa , t1.TVOL AS tvol , t1.TAMT AS tamt , t1.SHAR AS shar , t1.TOMV AS tomv , t1.T_RATE AS tRate , t1.TRD_TO_DATE AS trdToDate , TO_CHAR(t1.YMD, 'iw') AS week FROM SYT0LP t1 WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.JM_CD = #{jmCd} AND t1.YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -12) AND t1.YMD NOT IN ( SELECT ta.HOLI_YMD FROM SZX0HL ta WHERE ta.NATION_CD = 'US' AND ta.HOLI_YMD >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), -13) ) ORDER BY t1.YMD DESC
SELECT t1.SEBU_CD_EFNM FROM SZX0GR t1 WHERE t1.GR_CD = 'Q0' AND t1.SEBU_CD = #{stockGb} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT t1.CURRENCY FROM SZX0WA t1 WHERE t1.NATION_CD = #{nationCd} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT t1.NATION_CD FROM SZX0WA t1 WHERE t1.CURRENCY = #{currency} AND ROWNUM = 1
